connector.name: ASMHunter
connector.registryDescription: Drive ASMHunter attack-surface monitoring from an AI agent: recon, scans, findings, reports.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package asmhunter-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace app.asmhunter, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ASMHUNTER_TOKEN
env.description: ASMHunter Personal Access Token (asm_live_...). Mint one at asmhunter.app -> Settings -> API Tokens (Hunter tier or above).
